templates.title: Litter Habits
templates.goal: Develop a calm, voluntary litter habits routine suitable for rabbit.

lessons.title: Introduce and reinforce
steps: Introduce the context or equipment at a comfortable distance.
Reinforce voluntary approach and calm participation.
Increase duration gradually; stop before signs of distress.

successCriteria.description: Relaxed, voluntary participation across multiple sessions; no fixed threshold where inappropriate.

safetyNotes: Use voluntary, reward-based methods; never punish or force the behavior.
Stop at signs of distress, avoidance, or fatigue.
Adapt all practice to the species and individual.
templates.summary: Develop a calm, voluntary litter habits routine suitable for rabbit.

duration.evidenceBasis: No species-specific session duration has been verified for this template. The legacy estimatedSessionMinutes value, if present, is an unvalidated product estimate.

successCriteriaPolicy.rule: Advance only when the individual pet is comfortable and the behavior is repeatable; no arbitrary 80% pass requirement.
